title: Star-delta motor starter (timed state machine)
nl_spec: Implement a star-delta starter as a state machine with three states: 0 = Off, 1 = Star, 2 = Delta. On StartPB (when healthy) enter Star: energize the main contactor (MainK) and star contactor (StarK). After the motor has run in star for PT_STAR = 3 scan ticks, transition to Delta: de-energize StarK and energize the delta contactor (DeltaK); MainK stays on. StopPB or an activated emergency stop (EStop normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) returns to Off and de-energizes everything. SAFETY-CRITICAL: the star and delta contactors must NEVER be energized simultaneously. Use an internal INT State (0..2) and a TON timer. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named star_delta with inputs StartPB, StopPB, EStop and outputs MainK, StarK, DeltaK.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: The star and delta contactors are never energized at the same time.
When the emergency stop is activated, all contactors are de-energized.
Whenever stop is pressed, all contactors are de-energized.
A star or delta contactor is only energized while the main contactor is energized.

scenarios.description: Start in star, transition to delta after 3 ticks

notes: Timed CASE state machine with a contactor interlock. Timer gated by (State=1) at top level; transitions in a nested CASE; outputs derived from State.
